# UnfoldK

> All-in-one Hallyu platform for global K-pop, K-drama, and Korean culture fans — one subscription unlocks calendar tracking, drama discovery, Korean language learning, recipes, and travel guides.

UnfoldK (https://www.unfoldk.com) is operated by **UNFOLD LAB**, an indie developer based in Korea. The platform serves global K-culture fans (primarily English-speaking and Southeast Asia) with six interconnected services. Free signup, with a **Hallyu Pass** subscription unlocking Pro features across all services.

- Brand: UnfoldK ("Unfold Korea")
- Operator: UNFOLD LAB — Korea-based indie developer
- Target audience: Global K-culture fans (worldwide)
- Pricing: Free tier available. Hallyu Pass subscription ($15/month or $120/year) unlocks all Pro features.

## Services

- [HallyuCalendar](https://www.unfoldk.com/calendar): K-pop comeback schedules and Hallyu event calendar — track artist releases, drama premieres, and global concerts in one feed.
- [KdramaMatch](https://www.unfoldk.com/drama): K-drama discovery, personalized recommendations, and episode tracking with watchlists.
- [HangeulGo](https://www.unfoldk.com/korean): Daily Korean language learning grounded in K-drama dialogue and real expressions.
- [KfoodKit](https://www.unfoldk.com/food): Browse 537 Korean recipes and find substitute ingredients available in your country.
- [Curation K](https://www.unfoldk.com/curation-k): K-drama and K-pop filming locations plus curated Korea travel guides.
- [HallyuCalendar Events](https://www.unfoldk.com/calendar): Global Hallyu concert and event alerts — never miss a show in your city.
